description.value: Hot Cha Cafe is a dessert and bubble tea shop on Cambie Street in Vancouver, offering fresh fruit bubble teas, hot beverages, and a variety of snacks and desserts. The cafe is a potential refreshment stop for cyclists riding the Cambie Street corridor.
